title: Practice 1: за and под: going behind, under

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Простите за ___ (опоздание, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Pardon my being late.
exercises.why: **опоздание → опоздание** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -ие. Declines like DLI's здание — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. здание). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. опоздание · опоздания · опозданию · опоздание · опозданием · опоздании; pl. опоздания · опозданий · опозданиям · опоздания · опозданиями · опозданиях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Загляни под ___ (кожа, acc. sg.) цивилизованному человеку и ты обнаружишь варвара.
exercises.prompt: Look under the skin of a civilized man and you will find a barbarian.
exercises.why: **кожа → кожу** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а. Declines like DLI's газета — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. газету). Ending -а → -у.  Declension: sg. кожа · кожи · коже · кожу · кожей · коже; pl. кожи · кож · кожам · кожи · кожами · кожах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. exercises.q: Это не подходит ни под ___ (одна категория, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: This doesn't fit into any category.
exercises.why: **категория → категорию** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -ия. Declines like DLI's армия — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. армию). Ending -я → -ю.  **один → одну** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with категорию). «один» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (f. sg.): одна · одной · одной · одну · одной · одной.  Declension: sg. категория · категории · категории · категорию · категорией · категории; pl. категории · категорий · категориям · категории · категориями · категориях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Взрывное устройство было замаскировано под ___ (кассетный магнитофон, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The explosive device was disguised as a tape recorder.
exercises.why: **магнитофон → магнитофон** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **кассетный → кассетный** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with магнитофон). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. магнитофон · магнитофона · магнитофону · магнитофон · магнитофоном · магнитофоне; pl. магнитофоны · магнитофонов · магнитофонам · магнитофоны · магнитофонами · магнитофонах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Давай возьмёмся за ___ (рука, acc. pl.).
exercises.prompt: Let's hold hands.
exercises.why: **рука → руки** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural руки. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -и. exercises.q: Кто-то подкопался под ___ (наш забор, acc. sg.).

No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **наш → наш** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with забор). A possessive — declines like DLI's наш. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.
